source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: No hole map could be read, so the hole order is my best fit from the photo (pars, card lengths, walking order). Holes 2-4 were traced on a wider photo that shows the part north of the cross road.
unsure.1: Played north from the range/clubhouse side to the green by the road; the map marks this strip as the driving range, so this may be the range rather than a hole.
unsure.2: Traced on the wider photo: tee pads by the road, fairway north then bending left to the green east of the lake
unsure.3: Par 3 west across the corner of the lake from the tee pads north of it; green between bunkers. Which pad is the back tee is a guess
unsure.4: back tee moved to the top of the tee strip, now visible on the wider photo
unsure.9: Tee placed among the tee pads south of the lake, wrapping around the lake to the green beside the clubhouse.
unsure.12: Green position uncertain (on the east side of the pond); fairway follows the east corridor.
unsure.13: Shares the wide south-east fairway with 14 (played in opposite directions); the green with the bridge was a magazine's 15th green, so 13 and 15 may be swapped.
unsure.16: Tee placed just past the 15th green; traces about 90 yd shorter than the card.
unsure.18: Back tee moved to the row of tee pads west of the pond near the 17th green, playing north-east over the lake's inlet up the fairway; still a little under the card's back length
